title: Classic Candle Making Experience @ Waxery in Philadelphia
blurb: Craft your own unique candles in a creative 90-minute session at Waxery in Philadelphia. Enjoy the freedom to choose from various scents and styles, ensuring your candle reflects your personal touch. With options like classic or elegant wooden wicks, you’ll leave with two custom-made 8oz candles. This hands-on experience is perfect for groups of friends or family looking for an enjoyable activity. Plus, the BYOB facility adds an extra layer of fun, making it a great spot to unwind and get crafty.
